column1: # SpawnRecord+0x80 IS AN EMBEDDED BattleStatsRecord, AND THE TYPE STORE MODELS IT TWICE.
# 23 of SpawnRecord's 37 field rows fall inside [0x80, 0x248) - the window the unit-definition
# page identifies as a BattleStatsRecord inside the spawn record (0x80 + 0x1C8 = 0x248 <= 0x250).
# All 23 are UNRESOLVED on SpawnRecord. ELEVEN are already NAMED on BattleStatsRecord at exactly
# THE MAPPING IS CONFIRMED FROM THE PAGE'S OWN CITATIONS, twice, not from arithmetic alone:
#   SpawnRecord 0x242 -> BattleStatsRecord 0x1C2 `level`       page: "+0x1C2 = 0, the level byte"
# THE WRITER AGREES. FUN_0030C470 (Rewards_Progression_Economy, 432 B) fills the sub-object from
#   [rbx+0x08] = word row+0x16                 -> `baseHp`, which the store already sources to w_16
#   [rbx+0x0C] = word row+0x1A                 -> `baseMp`, already sourced to w_1A
#   [rbx+0x10/14/18/1C] = bytes row+0x1E, +0x21, +0x24, +0x27, each movzx -> movd -> cvtdq2ps
#                                              -> the `statBlockByKind` union region. The page calls
#                                                 these the base stats, "each followed by its growth
#                                                 byte" - which is exactly the 3-byte source stride.
#                                                 the range the page labels "the licence rank".
# NOTHING IS EDITED BY THIS FILE. Whether to model the window as one BattleStatsRecord field and
# drop the duplicates, or to keep them cross-referenced, is a STRUCTURAL decision that moves the
# field and unresolved-name totals four surfaces publish. Routed to SWE2-STRUCT.
# WHY IT MATTERS: 23 rows count as UNRESOLVED names while 11 of them are named in the same store
# at a known offset, so any 'how much is left to name' figure is inflated by that.
# Measured 2026-09-16 by OPUS from _types/fields.tsv and the disassembly of 0030C470
